title: astrology appulse: the params of scene.play

x.description: Offset on the sky from the still body, east to the left.

y.description: Offset on the sky from the still body, north up.

on.description: When this step shows: 0.3 + 5.4 i / 14 for step i.

off.description: When the next step takes over (the last one: 6).

path.description: The moving planet against the still one in 14 steps, 4 days either side of the closest moment. Scale: 0.32 over the larger of their separation and 0.08 degrees.

a.description: The planet in the middle: one of mercury to saturn, at least 12 degrees from the Sun.

b.description: The planet that passes within 0.5 degrees of it.
